patch_description:
The first program achieved the best validation accuracy (0.62) with 186 parameters including RX gates. The current program removed RX gates and added a third ZZZ gate, both of which appear to have degraded performance. This edit:

1. Restores the RX layer (which was present in the best-performing variant)
2. Rewires two CRZ gates to alternative connectivity patterns: crz_2 from [0,8] to [3,6] and crz_5 from [3,5] to [4,7], following the recommendation to explore different qubit coupling maps
3. Removes the third ZZZ gate (zzz_2) that was added in the current program, as it appears to have hurt generalization

This balances expressivity with parameter efficiency while testing new connectivity patterns that may better match the underlying data topology.
